audit: authored physical identity migration non-identity parity
comparison: exact parsed JSON equality after removing only authored physical identity fields; arrays and all remaining values/order are preserved
audit_exit_reason: The optional strict audit correctly exits nonzero for current non-identity donor updates; no baseline value was altered to conceal them.

summary.expected_donor_drift: D6e-R1 changed the shared Stik aerodynamic reference point and six derivative values/sources. It also introduced controls.rates on the base Stik; Glow generation intentionally removes rates pending fresh flight evidence.

differences.before: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim, about the CG, downwash settled; closed form 2*a_f*(S_t/S)*(l_t/c) = 3.13; the borrowed UltraStick 25e value was 6.1639
differences.after: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g, ARP-referred since D6e-R1): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim, downwash settled; the wing ahead of the CG loses lift in a pull, so it is below the tail-only closed form 2*a_f*(S_t/S)*(l_t/c) = 3.13; the borrowed UltraStick 25e value was 6.1639

differences.before: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim, about the CG, downwash settled; the downwash lag adds Cmadot -3.59 as a state (E0a2b), so Cmq+Cmadot = -11.07; closed-form tail -7.40; the borrowed UltraStick 25e value -13.5664 lumped both
differences.after: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g, ARP-referred since D6e-R1): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim gives -7.765 about the CG, downwash settled; written about the ARP so the oracle's r x F transfer of the CLq lift reproduces it; the downwash lag adds Cmadot -3.59 as a state (E0a2b); closed-form tail -7.40; the borrowed UltraStick 25e value -13.5664 lumped both

differences.before: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim, about the CG, downwash settled; fin -2*(l_v/b)*Cnb_fin plus wing profile -CD0/3 = -0.1324 (D11f); the borrowed UltraStick 25e value -0.1833 contradicts the fin-derived Cnb
differences.after: research/aero/d11g/derive_rate_derivatives.gd (D11g, ARP-referred since D6e-R1): the Stik's verified local model at the 15 m/s level trim gives -0.1320 about the CG, downwash settled; written about the ARP so the oracle's r x F transfer of the CYr side force reproduces it; fin -2*(l_v/b)*Cnb_fin plus wing profile -CD0/3 = -0.1324 (D11f); the borrowed UltraStick 25e value -0.1833 contradicts the fin-derived Cnb
